name: Iron Longsword
description: A reliable steel blade balanced for military drills and road defense.
effects: Provides plausible framing for close-quarters armed strikes and guard-breaking attempts.

name: Shortblade
description: A compact sidearm favored by scouts, sailors, and city patrols.
effects: Supports discreet melee actions in tight spaces where larger weapons are awkward.

name: Reinforced Leather Armor
description: Layered hide and boiled leather plates stitched over a padded vest.
effects: Provides narrative justification for reduced harm in glancing or partially blocked hits.

name: Trailkeeper Pack
description: A weatherproof bedroll-pack with rope, hooks, and field rations pouch.
effects: Supports overland travel readiness and basic camp setup in uncertain terrain.

name: Field Dressing Kit
description: Bandages, antiseptic tincture, and coarse pain-dulling herb wraps.
effects: Allows immediate first-aid narration where treatment conditions are plausible.
